lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Raag Bhairao, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hoi ||
lines.translation: Without You, nothing happens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too kar kar dekhahi jaanahi soi ||1||
lines.translation: You create the creatures, and gazing on them, you know them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa kaheeai kichh kahee na jaai ||
lines.translation: What can I say? I cannot say anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh ahai sabh teree rajaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever exists, is by Your Will. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karanaa s terai paas ||
lines.translation: Whatever is to be done, rests with You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kis aagai keechai aradaas ||2||
lines.translation: Unto whom should I offer my prayer? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan sunanaa teree baanee ||
lines.translation: I speak and hear the Bani of Your Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: too aape jaanahi sarab vidaanee ||3||
lines.translation: You Yourself know all Your Wondrous Play. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kare karaae jaanai aap ||
lines.translation: You Yourself act, and inspire all to act; only You Yourself know.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dekhai thaap uthaap ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, You, Lord, see, establish and disestablish. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bhairau mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bhairao, First Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad tare mun kete i(n)draadik brahamaad tare ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, so many silent sages have been saved; Indra and Brahma have also been saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਤਪਸੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sanak sana(n)dan tapasee jan kete gur parasaadee paar pare ||1||
lines.translation: Sanak, Sanandan and many humble men of austerity, by Guru's Grace, have been carried across to the other side. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhavajal bin sabadai kiu tareeai ||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੁਬਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa jag rog biaapiaa dubidhaa dub dub mareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is entangled in the disease of duality, and is drowned, drowned, and dies. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur devaa gur alakh abhevaa tribhavan sojhee gur kee sevaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru is Divine; the Guru is Inscrutable and Mysterious. Serving the Guru, the three worlds are known and understood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape daat karee gur daatai paaiaa alakh abhevaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Guru, the Giver, has Himself given me the Gift; I have obtained the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man raajaa man man te maaniaa manasaa manahi samaaee ||
lines.translation: The mind is the king; the mind is appeased and satisfied through the mind itself, and desire is stilled in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man jogee man binas biogee man samajhai gun gaaee ||3||
lines.translation: The mind is the Yogi, the mind wastes away in separation from the Lord; singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the mind is instructed and reformed. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te man maariaa sabad veechaariaa te virale sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: How very rare are those in this world who, through the Guru, subdue their minds, and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib bharipur leenaa saach sabad nisataaraa ||4||1||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is All-pervading; through the True Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated. ||4||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਰਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: nainee drisat nahee tan heenaa jar jeetiaa sir kaalo ||
lines.translation: The eyes lose their sight, and the body withers away; old age overtakes the mortal, and death hangs over his head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਛੋਡੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: roop ra(n)g rahas nahee saachaa kiu chhodai jam jaalo ||1||
lines.translation: Beauty, loving attachment and the pleasures of life are not permanent. How can anyone escape from the noose of death? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanee har jap janam gaio ||
lines.translation: O mortal, meditate on the Lord - your life is passing away!
